intro: After What the Flux?, Master Smith Burninate turns to replenishing the dwindling supply of fiery flux in the Searing Gorge. Burninate wants incendosaur scales, iron bars, and coal, and will take all you can offer.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Let's not waste more of my precious time with jibber jabber, traveler. It's time to focus on replenishing our dwindling fiery flux supply.
What I'm gonna need from you is the following:
I'll take all that you can offer!
And you'll do it fast if you wanna get in good with the Brotherhood.

clips.title: Completion
paras: There's always room for more fiery flux, junior. Keep it comin'... Unless I tell you to stop.
